cases.reply: Yes — cancelling three days ahead is more than 48 hours of notice, which qualifies for a full refund of the amount you paid.

Once a refund is approved, it goes back to your original payment method, and card refunds usually show up within 5 to 10 business days depending on your bank. If you paid with Apple Pay or Google Pay, it follows the timeline of the linked card. We aren't able to send refunds to a different card or to a bank account.

Yes — changes made less than 24 hours before the appointment carry a $25 late change fee, since the professional has already planned their route. If you move it at least 24 hours ahead, rescheduling is free. You can reschedule a booking up to two times before needing to cancel and rebook.

A deep cleaning is $240 for homes up to 1,500 square feet, so a small apartment would fall at that base price. It includes inside cabinets, baseboards, oven, fridge interior, and window sills on top of our standard cleaning, and all supplies are included.

Yes, we serve Denver, Colorado, covering addresses up to 25 miles from downtown. Just enter your ZIP code in the app to confirm your address is within coverage before booking.

Yes — our plumbers (and electricians) must hold a valid state license, and we verify it before they're activated. They also pass identity verification and a criminal background check before their first job, repeated annually, plus a skills assessment and safety training.

You can request account deletion in the app under Account Settings, then Privacy. You'll need to cancel any upcoming bookings first, and your account is deleted within 30 days. We do retain payment and invoice records for seven years, as tax law requires.

On Sundays, human support agents are available from 9 AM to 5 PM Central Time. Just ask the assistant to connect you with a person, and during those hours an agent usually replies within 15 minutes. If you reach out outside those hours, your conversation is queued and an agent replies first thing the next morning.
